blocks.prompt: 16. An AC circuit has an impedance of \(Z = 3 - 6i\) ohms and is connected to a voltage source of \(V = 90 + 30i\) volts. Find the current in both rectangular and polar form.
blocks.explanation: Phir AC circuit ka Ohm's law: \(V = IZ\), is liye \(I = V/Z\). Is baar V aur Z dono rectangular form mein hain, is liye taqseem conjugate ke zariye karenge: upar aur neeche dono ko Z ke conjugate se zarb. Phir jawab ko polar form mein bhi likhna hai. Aakhir mein \(IZ = V\) se check karenge, jo answer key ki ghalti bhi pakar leta hai.
steps:
Given (diya gaya hai): \(Z = 3 - 6i\) ohms, \(V = 90 + 30i\) volts.
To find (maloom karna hai): current \(I\), rectangular aur polar dono forms mein.
Method (tareeqa): \(I = \frac{V}{Z}\); rectangular form mein taqseem ke liye upar neeche \(\overline{Z} = 3 + 6i\) se zarb.

Qadam 1: Taqseem ki tayyari
\[I = \dfrac{90 + 30i}{3 - 6i} \times \dfrac{3 + 6i}{3 + 6i}\]
Kyun: \((3 - 6i)(3 + 6i)\) ek real number hai, is liye neeche se i khatam ho jayega. \(\frac{3 + 6i}{3 + 6i} = 1\) hai, is liye value nahi badalti.

Qadam 2: Upar zarb karein
\[(90 + 30i)(3 + 6i)\]
\[= 270 + 540i + 90i + 180i^{2}\]
\[= 270 - 180 + 630i\]
\[= 90 + 630i\]
Kyun: chaar products (har term har term se), phir \(i^{2} = -1\), is liye \(180i^{2} = -180\).
Dhyan dein: \(+180i^{2}\) ko \(+180\) likh dena aam ghalti hai; \(i^{2}\) hamesha \(-1\) hai.

Qadam 3: Neeche zarb karein
\[(3 - 6i)(3 + 6i) = 9 + 36 = 45\]
Kyun: \((a - ib)(a + ib) = a^{2} + b^{2}\): \(9 + 36 = 45\). Middle terms cancel ho jaati hain.

Qadam 4: Taqseem karein
\[I = \dfrac{90 + 630i}{45} = 2 + 14i\]
Kyun: \(90 \div 45 = 2\) aur \(630 \div 45 = 14\); dono parts ko alag alag taqseem kiya.

Qadam 6: Polar form: argument
\[\theta = \tan^{-1}\dfrac{14}{2} = \tan^{-1} 7\]
\[\theta \approx 81.87^{\circ}\]
\[I = 10\sqrt{2}(\cos 81.87^{\circ} + i\sin 81.87^{\circ})\]
Kyun: dono parts positive hain, I first quadrant mein hai, is liye calculator ka angle hi sahi hai (\(\approx 1.429\) rad).

Tasdeeq (check): \(IZ\) se V aana chahiye.
\[(2 + 14i)(3 - 6i)\]
\[= 6 - 12i + 42i - 84i^{2}\]
\[= 6 + 84 + 30i = 90 + 30i \;✓\]
Answer key ka \(18i\) fail hota hai: \(18i(3 - 6i) = 108 + 54i \neq V\).
blocks.final_answer: Rectangular form: \(I = 2 + 14i\) A; polar form: \(I = 10\sqrt{2}(\cos 81.87^{\circ} + i\sin 81.87^{\circ}) \approx 14.14\) A, \(81.87^{\circ}\) par.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key Sawal 16 ka jawab "Rectangular form: \(0 + 18i\), Polar form: \(18\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{2} + i\sin\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\)" likhti hai. Yeh ghalat hai: \(18i \times (3 - 6i) = 108 + 54i\), \(90 + 30i\) nahi. Sahi current \(I = 2 + 14i = 10\sqrt{2}(\cos 81.87^{\circ} + i\sin 81.87^{\circ})\) hai.
